description: Screenshot of Q drop #854, posted Mar 06 2018 01:09:09 with tripcode !UW.yye1fxo, as rendered by a Q aggregator. description: Screenshot of a Facebook post by an account named George M. Nasif, posted publicly '1 hr' before capture. The post claims arrests are coming tied to the NXIVM and Epstein cases and asserts, without evidence, that three videos from 'Weiner's laptop' exist depicting Hillary Clinton and Huma Abedin committing graphic abuse of minors, which the poster says he 'can't legally show'. These are versions of the debunked 'frazzledrip' conspiracy claims; no such videos have ever been produced or verified.

description: Patriotic meme: a daytime photograph of a WWII-era tank displayed as a monument on a grassy field, painted olive drab with white U.S. star markings, beside a tall flagpole flying the American flag against a blue sky with wispy clouds; trees line the background. Bold white block-letter caption reads 'FOR GOD / AND COUNTRY'. The tank's turret and hull profile are consistent with an M4 Sherman; the location is not identified.
flags: Tank type consistent with an M4 Sherman but not confirmed by markings

description: Screenshot of Q drop #1896 (Aug 15 2018, tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI) quoting an Anonymous 8chan post whose attached ClipboardImage.png is a tight crop of what appears to be a painting or old photograph: red cords strung with numerous silver charms, medallions and amulets draped over a white garment, a small child's hand grasping one charm, part of a child's head at bottom, and an adult hand holding a dark blue book at upper right. Q replies to the image only 'Below hand.', directing anons to examine the area beneath the hand. Neither the artwork nor the persons in it are identified in the image.

description: Widely published 1972-era portrait of heiress Gloria Vanderbilt, in a white high-collared gown and layered red-corded charm necklaces, reclining on a brass bed against pink gingham walls and bedding with two young boys in blue striped pajamas, one holding a stuffed animal. Above the headboard hangs a colorful folk-art altarpiece/retablo with a black-robed Madonna figure, angels, sun and moon cutouts. The children are widely identified in published sources as her sons Anderson and Carter Cooper; the cropped detail Q highlighted in drop #1896 (the charm necklaces and a child's hand) comes from this photograph, which circulated in Q threads with claims about the altar imagery.
flags: Children kept unnamed in people per minors rule; widely published sources identify them as Anderson and Carter Cooper
Q-thread claims about occult significance of the altar/necklaces are interpretations, not established fact
